newsitem.title: UK: London shares marked lower following Wall St slide.
newsitem.headline: London shares marked lower following Wall St slide.

text.p: UK shares pushed lower on Monday but selling pressure was light as market makers adjusted prices following Wall Street's 148-point plunge on Friday.
A steady bond market helped put limit the downside as investors awaited a batch of economic data due later this week, dealers said.

"We had a predictable mark-down at the start but that attracted only a few sellers," the head of sales and trading at a large brokerage said. "Basically, nobody is interested in getting involved until they see how the Dow opens."
The FTSE 100 opened 37.8 points down to 4,232.9.
